cue: Regeneration or random-clock integrability is inferred only from an unspecified exponential spatial-range tail, without comparing its rate to the clock cost or citing a theorem that handles that rate.
fire_when: Claim: UE plus some exponential regeneration-range tail automatically gives finite mean duration, using only a fixed-box escape estimate.
silent_when: A complete valid theorem supplies the necessary rate, or a dimension-sensitive argument handles weaker rates; also silent outside clock integrability.
text: Compare the spatial-tail exponent with the clock cost. UE plus some exponential range tail does not ensure a finite mean general clock (w453 L3). For conditioning on no backtracking, use the original-law bound divided by its event probability.
